ValidationRule.description: Status can only changed to Approved or Expired from Suspended Status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( TEXT( PRIORVALUE( CLA_Status__c ) ) = 'Suspended' , TEXT( CLA_Status__c ) <> 'Expired' , TEXT( CLA_Status__c ) <> 'Approved', TEXT( CLA_Status__c ) <> 'Suspended', TEXT( CLA_Status__c ) <> 'Under Review')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Status can only changed to Approved or Expired or Under Review from Suspended Status.
